about.title: Management thinking backed by analytical execution.
paragraphs: I studied Industrial Management at New Uzbekistan University in a fully English-taught programme. My academic and professional work sits at the intersection of operations, finance, business analysis, technology and project delivery.
I am particularly interested in how organizations improve performance through better processes, stronger cost visibility, effective ERP adoption and disciplined decision making.

experience.description: Coordinate requirements, scope and cross-functional delivery for a B2B e-commerce platform, translating operational needs into structured workflows and implementation priorities.
Worked with business requirements, process analysis, workflow definition and reporting to support clearer decisions and more structured delivery.
Gained international work experience in a fast-paced operational environment while living and working independently in Nuremberg, Germany.
